snippet.title: What We Bring - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

WIshlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4500870/What_We_Bring/

Coming 2026 on Steam
